author: Mark Atwood
text: Workspace-canonical reclassification filed as JMAP-x2gd.86. The doc-gap shape this bead describes is present on the canonical extension-server template (jmap-mail-server) as well — chat-server is cookie-cut from mail-server's thin foundation-methods docs. Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' propagation rule, the fix must land on mail-server first then propagate to all 8 extension-server crates in the same pass. Leaving .59 open as the chat-server manifestation; it will close when JMAP-x2gd.86's sweep lands and propagates here.
